content.intro: In this lesson, you will study java packages with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you organize code and control access through packages, modules, and deliberate dependencies. In this lesson, focus on declaring packages and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Packages organize names and access boundaries; the module system adds explicit module dependencies and exports. Keep public API surface intentional and verify classpath/module-path settings when troubleshooting. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.
